title: Kyber to Showcase at Guidewire Connections 2026
summary: Guidewire PartnerConnect Technology partner and sponsor will demonstrate how insurers can streamline claims correspondence directly within the claims workflow
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, NY, 10/20/2026** . Kyber, the claims correspondence platform built for property and casualty insurers, announced its participation as a Bronze sponsor at **Guidewire Connections 2026** , taking place October 26–29 at Fontainebleau Las Vegas.


Connections brings together insurers, technology providers, and leaders from across the P&C ecosystem to explore the technology and ideas shaping the future of insurance.


As a Guidewire PartnerConnect Technology partner, Kyber has recently advanced from the Growth tier to the Advantage tier within the program. Kyber uses live claim data, approved content, and relevant supporting information to help carriers draft, review, and deliver regulated correspondence directly within the claims workflow. This gives adjusters a clearer starting point while helping carriers maintain consistency and control at scale.


Carriers using Kyber have reduced[letter cycle times by 5x](https://www.askkyber.com/news/branch-cuts-letter-cycle-time-by-5x-with-kyber) and[automated more than 40% of outgoing correspondence within a single quarter.](https://www.askkyber.com/news/aspire-automation) By connecting Kyber and Guidewire ClaimCenter, carriers can turn the information already captured throughout the claim into communications that are clearer for claimants and more efficient for the teams supporting them.


‍


“Adjusters can spend up to 40% of their day drafting and reviewing notices instead of resolving claims,” said Arvind Sontha, CEO of Kyber. “By integrating Kyber with ClaimCenter, teams can use the claim information already available to create, review, and deliver compliant correspondence with intuitive template management and built-in governance.”


## **See Kyber at Connections**


Connections attendees can visit **Kyber** throughout the conference to meet the team and see how Kyber works with Guidewire to streamline claims correspondence from creation through delivery.


On **Wednesday, October 28** , Arvind Sontha will be speaking at the **Spotlight Theater** stage for a live demonstration of Kyber. The session will show how claims teams can build and manage templates, generate correspondence using claim information and approved language, and move documents through review, audit, and fulfillment within an integrated workflow.

## **About Kyber**


Kyber is a claims correspondence platform built for property and casualty insurers. Kyber brings document generation, template management, review and approval workflows, governance, and multi-channel delivery into a single platform designed around how claims teams work.


By connecting directly with core claims systems, Kyber helps carriers turn claim information into clear, compliant communications while reducing manual work and giving business teams greater control over the correspondence process.


Learn more at **askkyber.com** .
